title: "11_DGE_PanCK_Endometriosis_Sensitivity"
subtitle: "Sensitivity analysis of 10 adjusted for menstrual phase and COC use (Supplementary Figure 5)"
author: "Luca Mastrantoni"
output: html_document
---

Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03), `DATA_INPUT/unique_pt_public.xlsx`
Output: Supp. Fig. 5 (FigureS5, S5a-S5b) in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Supplementary/FigureS5` and `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Supplementary/FigureS5`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))

# Patient-level covariates
patients <- read_xlsx(file.path(path_input, "unique_pt_public.xlsx"))
idx <- match(as.character(spe_ruv$Patient), patients$Patient)
spe_ruv$Menstrual <- patients$Menstrual[idx]
spe_ruv$COC <- patients$COC[idx]

endometriosis <- c("Simple endometriosis", "Atypical endometriosis", "Endometriosis CLE")
keep <- spe_ruv$Segment == "PanCK" & spe_ruv$Category %in% endometriosis
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, keep]
dge <- spe_to_dge(spe_ruv)[, keep]
```

##### Differential expression
```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Category + COC + Menstrual + ruv_W1 + ruv_W2 + ruv_W3, data = colData(spe_sub)) %>%
  tidy_design("Category")
contr.matrix <- makeContrasts(ECLE_SE = Endometriosis_CLE - Simple_endometriosis,
                              ECLE_AE = Endometriosis_CLE - Atypical_endometriosis,
                              levels = colnames(design))

efit <- fit_dge(dge, design, contr.matrix, block = factor(colData(spe_sub)$Patient))$efit

topTable_ECLE_SE <- top_table(efit, "ECLE_SE")
topTable_ECLE_AE <- top_table(efit, "ECLE_AE")
```

##### Supplementary Figure 5
```{r, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 7.5}
v1 <- plot_volcano(topTable_ECLE_SE, sig_genes_in(topTable_ECLE_SE, volcano_genes_endometriosis),
                   col_low = Category[["Simple endometriosis"]], col_high = Category[["Endometriosis CLE"]], xlim = c(-6, 6), ylim = c(0, 10),
                   left = "SE", right = "ECLE", caption_y = 9, label_pt = 4.2, box_padding = 0.5)
v2 <- plot_volcano(topTable_ECLE_AE, sig_genes_in(topTable_ECLE_AE, volcano_genes_endometriosis),
                   col_low = Category[["Atypical endometriosis"]], col_high = Category[["Endometriosis CLE"]], xlim = c(-6, 6), ylim = c(0, 10),
                   left = "AE", right = "ECLE", caption_y = 9, label_pt = 4.2, box_padding = 0.5)
FigureS5 <- v1 + v2 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = letter_size(15)))
FigureS5

save_plot(FigureS5, "FigureS5.svg", width = 15, height = 7.5)   # 15 in wide: prints at 50% on the page

# Single panels
save_plot(v1, "FigureS5a.svg", width = 10, height = 10)
save_plot(v2, "FigureS5b.svg", width = 10, height = 10)
save_source_data(volcano_source(v1), "FigureS5a")
save_source_data(volcano_source(v2), "FigureS5b")
```
